description: Riku Richard Multimieli: four portraits, a first-person well, and links to the work.
name: Riku Richard Multimieli

tie.heading: Road
tie.quote: The glass decides which faces arrive.
tie.p1: He sits belted in, coat on, and looks past. The road does not ask a name. It offers a frequency, and he passes through it until the edge of the forest is nothing but light.
tie.p2: The coat is liturgy. The story is not driven. It is allowed to come.
tie.alt: Riku Richard Multimieli on the road

minusta.heading: Of Me
minusta.p1: In a medieval register, the register that does not beg leave of its own century.
minusta.p2: I grew up in the fever of the Nokia boom, at the Hervanta Research Center, in a melting pot of cultures. I played there while my mother was at work. The terrain was strange: glass, concrete, foreign languages, and the quiet pride of machines. There I learned that the world is a laboratory before anyone consents to call it one.
minusta.p3: Later I returned on my own to that same strange terrain. I completed a degree in biotechnology and specialized in artificial intelligence: a return to the same yard, this time with an adult's keys.
minusta.p4: I have spent most of my life thinking. The world, psychology, and the sciences have not been side paths. They have been the climate I have lived in.
minusta.p5: I have made two-month journeys, to Bali, Italy, Thailand, and Mexico, and drawn my soul from ancient ruins and from art. The ruins were not attractions. They were mirrors that remembered me before I was.
minusta.p6: Around the age of twenty I led a brain-chemistry group of ten thousand people. Its purpose was psychonautics and self-inquiry: a shared attempt to look inward until the map begins to answer.

kaari.heading: Arch
kaari.quote: Nearness is not a coat of arms.
kaari.p1: Between two cheeks there is an arch that needs no roof. The other face stays unnamed, because a name would already be distance.
kaari.p2: He keeps that face beside him the way he keeps a frequency: quietly, cheek to cheek.
kaari.alt: Riku Richard Multimieli under the arch

vesi.heading: Water
vesi.quote: The mouth is a door a god tried to leave by.
vesi.p1: On the shore the body agrees to be a shore. The beard is weather. The voice opens, and the water receives it without an altar.
vesi.p2: The flaying is not done with a knife. It is done by laughter refusing holiness.
vesi.alt: Riku Richard Multimieli on the shore

metsa.heading: Forest
metsa.quote: The hat is a shadow the forest lent.
metsa.p1: The hair is weather that refused to end. Here the familiar and the stranger live in the same trunk.
metsa.p2: Father Unheimlich does not rule the grove. He stands in it until the trees remember the name for him.
metsa.alt: Riku Richard Multimieli in the forest

close.p: They are tools by which one man keeps many minds in one place. Frequencies come. Gods leave without their skins. He stays.

title: Bio
